C0993.title: Lending an Account Becomes Accomplice: Hekou Bureau Dismantles Fraud Black Chain in "Helping Information Network Crime" Case
C0993.summary: In early 2025, Jiang lent his personal social media account to former colleague Liu, who used it to commit online fraud. By October 2025, the Hekou Public Security Bureau's cyber unit cracked the case; Liu was detained on suspicion of fraud, and Jiang was placed under criminal coercive measures for suspected aiding information network criminal activity.

references.title: 'Righteous' Account Lending Becomes 'Accomplice': Hekou Branch Dismantles Black Chain in 'Winter Shield' Operation, Cracking Fraud Case Involving Account Sharing
